title.zh: 确定之处检验固定相同

statement.zh: 两个框架都在相同之下确定时，配置恰在通过同样的检验时相同；没有相同之下确定这一条件时，检验未必固定相同。
statement.en: Where both frames' branching is determined up to likeness, configurations are alike exactly where they pass the same tests; without determinacy up to likeness the tests need not fix likeness.

claim.zh: 设 F 与 G 是动作与主张类型相同的框架。s 与 s′ 通过同样的检验（SameTests F G s s′），指从两者出发开放的动作序列相同，且每个序列之后能实现的主张相同；相同的配置如此（Alike.sameTests）。两者在相同之下确定时，同样的检验在一个动作之后保持（SameTests.after），通过同样的检验是一个互模拟（sameTests_bisimulation），所以配置恰在通过同样的检验时相同（alike_iff_sameTests；对一个确定的框架，Determined.alike_iff_sameTests）。没有相同之下确定这一条件时，检验未必固定相同：在第一步之后选择的框架与在第一步选择的框架，起点通过同样的检验而不相同（Choosing.sameTests、Choosing.not_alike），后者不确定（Choosing.early_not_determined）。不加前提，构造性。
claim.en: Let F and G be frames with the same move and claim types. Configurations s and s′ pass the same tests (SameTests F G s s′) where the same courses of moves are open from each and after each course the same claims can be realized; alike configurations do (Alike.sameTests). Where both frames are determined up to likeness, passing the same tests survives a move (SameTests.after) and is a bisimulation (sameTests_bisimulation), so configurations are alike exactly where they pass the same tests (alike_iff_sameTests; for one determined frame, Determined.alike_iff_sameTests). Without determinacy up to likeness the tests need not fix likeness: a frame choosing after its first move and one choosing at it pass the same tests from their starts and are not alike (Choosing.sameTests, Choosing.not_alike), the second not determined (Choosing.early_not_determined). No premise; constructive.

hypotheses.zh: alike_iff_sameTests 以两个框架处处在相同之下确定为条件；没有这个条件，Choosing 给出反例。
hypotheses.en: alike_iff_sameTests takes both frames determined up to likeness everywhere as its condition; without it, Choosing gives a counterexample.

hypotheses.zh: 检验是有限动作序列，可带一个最后的主张；带否定与合取的分支检验在外围（ExplanatoryBranching）。
hypotheses.en: A test is a finite course of moves, possibly followed by one claim; branching tests with negation and conjunction are in the periphery (ExplanatoryBranching).

correspondence.zh: P76 的第二项（工作板），按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“move towards 100%”：给出 configurations-alike-by-relation 的 next_delta 中“核心中经同样检验推出相同的构造性条件”：相同之下的确定性。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：检验看不到的是选择在何时作出；有分支时，只有分支的检验看得到。外围中像有限的模型的分支检验固定相同（same_iff_bisimilar，经典），经 P69 的桥接节（branching_bisimulation_iff）与核心的互模拟相连。见整合文档 §98。
correspondence.en: The second item of P76 (work board), following Ren's “move towards 100%” of 12 October 2026: it gives what configurations-alike-by-relation's next_delta names, a constructive condition in the core under which passing the same tests makes configurations alike: determinacy up to likeness. Reading (the AI's, pending Ren): what tests cannot see is when a choice is made; with branching, only tests that branch see it. In the periphery, branching tests fix likeness for image-finite models (same_iff_bisimilar, classically), joined to the core's bisimulation by P69's bridge section (branching_bisimulation_iff). See the integration document §98.

detail.zh: 复用 Bisimulation、Alike、Alike.trace、Alike.tests 与 DeterminedAt；给出它的 next_delta 所求的构造性条件。
detail.en: Reuses Bisimulation, Alike, Alike.trace, Alike.tests and DeterminedAt; gives the constructive condition its next_delta asks for.

output.zh: 相同及其在检验与相同之下确定性上的性质。
output.en: Likeness and its properties on tests and determinacy up to likeness.

input.zh: 检验固定相同的条件与反例。
input.en: The condition under which tests fix likeness, and its counterexample.

conditions.zh: 两个框架处处在相同之下确定。
conditions.en: Both frames determined up to likeness everywhere.

detail.zh: 外围中像有限的模型的分支检验恰固定相同（经典）；这里是核心中的线性检验，条件是相同之下的确定性。
detail.en: In the periphery, branching tests fix likeness exactly for image-finite models (classically); here linear tests in the core, under determinacy up to likeness.

detail.zh: Choosing：在第一步之后选择与在第一步选择的两个框架，通过同样的检验而不相同。
detail.en: Choosing: frames choosing after and at the first move pass the same tests and are not alike.

limitations.zh: 核心中分支检验固定相同没有陈述（外围的证明用经典逻辑；在配置有限的框架上是否有构造性证明，这里开放）；读法是 AI 的，待 Ren；不含伦理谓词。
limitations.en: That branching tests fix likeness is not stated in the core (the periphery's proof reasons classically; whether a constructive proof exists for frames with finitely many configurations is open here); the readings are the AI's, pending Ren; no ethical predicate occurs.

validation_scope.en: 14 October 2026: the current bytes of Becoming.Unfolding are bound to consolidated receipt 20261013T204910.042715Z (passed: 85 package modules, 4861 theorems, 6856 declaration audits, every source declaration with an empty axiom report; the 86-module core closure compiles from the prelude). Earlier receipts below checked the same statements under the former names, tabulated in plan section 10. Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 27 theorems of Becoming.Histories all have empty axiom reports, among them Alike.sameTests, SameTests.after, sameTests_bisimulation, alike_iff_sameTests, Determined.alike_iff_sameTests, Choosing.sameTests, Choosing.not_alike and Choosing.early_not_determined. The same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §98 of the integration note; there is no independent review yet.

next_delta.zh: 配置有限、步与主张已定的框架上，分支检验固定相同的构造性证明，或它需要哪个逻辑原则的边界。
next_delta.en: A constructive proof that branching tests fix likeness on frames with finitely many configurations and decided steps and claims, or the boundary naming the logical principle it needs.
